messages:
noah: Quick sync request from Beta customer: they want a single call that runs a small rerank, calls out to an external enrich service, and then produces a merged structured payload. they want parallelism but also a "commit" step that runs only if checks pass. doable?
rachel: Short answer: yes, but need to codify the modes. MVP should support: (A) parallel-merge (best-effort), (B) staged-commit (parallel then commit), (C) strict-seq. keep API surface minimal.
devon: Agree. We should introduce an explicit "stage" primitive in the request model so clients can express "parallel within stage" and "blocking between stages". that avoids ad-hoc after: semantics.
sophie: Important: define merge semantics for structured outputs. if two tools provide overlapping fields, which wins? options: first-wins, highest-confidence, client-specified resolver. recommend default = client-specified resolver with fallback to highest-confidence.
tariq: Failure modes: 1) soft-fail (include tool error in response, continue), 2) hard-fail (abort request), 3) compensating (call rollback tool). MVP: default soft-fail + overall request status. allow per-tool policy to override.
noah: Also need to handle rerank: reranking must happen after candidate generators finish. that's a stage boundary. if generators run parallel and some time out, reranker should accept partial candidate set and tag it.
rachel: UX for timeouts: per-tool timeout + stage timeout. stage timeout triggers stage termination and moves to next stage with whatever succeeded. document clear status codes: success, timed_out, failed, cancelled.
devon: Idempotency model: require idempotency_key per top-level request if server retries are enabled. for per-tool retries, require per-tool idempotency_key or inherit parent key + tool id.
sophie: Privacy: signal to tooling whether tool outputs contain PII so we can redact before storing traces. add `sensitive: true|false` in tool metadata; default false. any sensitive outputs must not be persisted in long-term traces.
tariq: Observability: we need per-tool timing + bytes + token counts + retry_count. also include stage-level aggregate. expose via Console and via a compact summary in response for pilots.
noah: Pricing note: product & finance want a simple model for customers: base orchestration fee + per-tool invocation units. highlight example scenarios showing cost delta between parallel and sequential modes.
rachel: SDKs: provide StageBuilder API with `addGenerators([...])`, `addRerank()`, `addCommit()` helpers. also include a raw JSON payload option for advanced users. ship Node + Python first.
devon: Performance gating: ensure that enabling parallel-toolflows does not regress single-request token latencies by >5% across our baseline workloads. build a microbench harness that simulates N parallel external calls with configurable latency distributions.
sophie: Merge conflict examples in docs: show how conflict resolvers can be simple templates, e.g., `resolver: {strategy: "field_priority", order: ["toolA","toolB"]}` and a confidence-based example.
tariq: Rollout: feature flag default off. Canary with internal teams first, then invited beta customers (Acme and BetaCo). for Dedicated, enable behind opt-in. Private deployments will require a config char for outbound integration proxies.
ops-bot: canary-deploy: staged-parallel-orch v1 started canary in eu-central-1 (build 2026.03.21-rc4)
noah: Roadmap items after MVP: transactional commits (compensating workflows), cross-tool atomicity primitives (post-MVP), richer conflict resolvers, audit-mode for retention rules.
rachel: Open decisions for next sync: default merge resolver, whether stage timeout should be configurable per-stage or only per-tool, and billing unit granularity.
devon: I'll draft the Stage schema and a minimal request example by EOD today.
sophie: I'll sketch merge resolver DSL and example docs.
tariq: I'll own perf harness and tracing changes.
noah: Sync Friday 9am to lock scope. thanks everyone. :rocket:
